{{Quote|The former Jedi Master first reappeared on Raxus Prime, complete with fiery rhetoric lambasting the Senate and the Jedi order's complacency in the visible erosion of morals and ideals of the Republic. Since that well documented speech two years ago, Dooku has been spotted on worlds throughout the Outer Rim, fomenting secession and leading a popular movement that soon developed an alarming cohesion.|"[[Who is Count Dooku?]]"|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_1.html|Dooku Spotted in Gree Enclave}}</ref>}}
The '''Raxus Address''' was a speech delivered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] renunciate [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]<ref name="EGW:85" /> on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]<ref name="HNN" /> in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="EGW:85" /> Utilizing fiery rhetoric,<ref name="HNN" /> Dooku condemned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] and Jedi for allowing the ideals and morals of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to decline. Dooku broadcast the speech via a hijacked Republic communications station in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. The Address coincided with the formation of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and triggered a series of secessions by various [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="EGW:85" />
